summary: Arkose is a young Hearthian found by the Ghost Matter fence in the Village, throwing rocks into the invisible Ghost Matter patch. They are excited by Ghost Matter as a kid would be by anything dangerous.

behavior: Arkose throws rocks into the Ghost Matter patch behind the Village fence.
Arkose considers Ghost Matter 'awesome' precisely because it is dangerous.
Arkose dismisses safety warnings as 'grown-up' talk.
Arkose reacts with excitement to learning that Tektite lost a foot to Ghost Matter.
Arkose wishes the Little Scout could shoot Ghost Matter at things.
location: Arkose is found by the Ghost Matter fence in the Village, outside the entrance to the Zero-G Cave.
lore: Arkose learned from Gossan that the Village Ghost Matter patch was bigger when Gossan was a hatchling.
Arkose knows Ghost Matter evaporates over a very long time scale.
Arkose hopes the Village's Ghost Matter patch is still around when they grow up.
mechanics: If the Protagonist stands in front of a thrown rock, the rock can hit them and knock them slightly backwards.
Arkose's rocks cause no damage but can knock the Protagonist into the Ghost Matter if they are standing on the fence.
